display.title: Episode 433: The King and the Shabbos Candles (Summer Vacation)
display.summary_short: At the start of summer vacation, Uncle Yossi asks children to help new friends come closer to Torah, then tells how a Shabbos candle saved a king's life and invites girls to light their own Shabbos candles.
display.summary_long: Broadcast at the very start of summer vacation in 5750. Uncle Yossi explains that by Divine providence Hashem arranges in advance which new friends you will meet in camp or at home, so that you can help them come closer to Torah and mitzvos; he invites listeners to write in and tell how they did it. After the Hakochainik march, two sisters, students at Beis Rivkah, recite the Shema in Studio 604, everyone gives tzedakah, and listeners say a prayer for the recovery of a sick three-year-old child. Story time tells of a king who banned candles after one set fire to his new study, leaving the Jews without Shabbos candles. The rabbi gathers the community to say Tehillim and urges every mother and daughter to light. Lost in a Friday snowstorm, the king is guided to safety by a Shabbos candle and lifts his decree. Uncle Yossi then speaks about bringing nachas to parents through kibbud av va'em, explains why Torah and mitzvos are compared to light, and asks every girl to light her own Shabbos candle beside her mother. The show ends with candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: Help every new friend come closer to Hashem, and bring light and nachas home: girls, light your own Shabbos candle beside Mommy.
